content_sections.heading: DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026 is October 1, 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026. These positions are for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk position, candidates must have passed SSLC (10th class) or an equivalent examination and possess computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Office Assistant post is an 8th class pass from a recognized Government or Private School Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment drive is 42 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the available data.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Office Assistant will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 13,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted for DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026 must be submitted in offline mode, either in person or by post.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Office, Integrated Multi-purpose Complex, District Employment Office - 625531.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, no application fee is mentioned for the DCPU Theni Recruitment 2026. Candidates should verify this in the official notification.
